opening.argument: The presentation actively promotes a paid mining package by tying a €12,500 purchase to token splits and lower mining difficulty. It presents the package as the “most superior package” even for new participants, while projecting capital appreciation of 860 percent. The description reinforces that invitation with a direct “Join now” signup link. Although the figures are described as projections, the video still encourages viewers to purchase the package for mining-linked token returns, making the qualification insufficient to remove the promotional character.

citations.quote: For 12,500 Euros, like the Tycoon, you get two splits. More importantly you can put the tokens in right now and it's got a lower mining difficulty.
a huge capital appreciation at 860 percent
even for new people coming in, the value of this package is our most superior package to date
